ABOUT.P1: My passion for development was born after I finished university and realized that my job did not fulfill me. I had always liked technology but had never seen it as more than a hobby until one day, while browsing the internet, I came across my first lines of code. After a couple of console games, I decided to dive in and balance (once again) work and studies.
ABOUT.P21: Today I have the privilege of working on diverse projects, focusing on end-to-end
ABOUT.P22: solutions in production: from defining requirements with the client to architecture, development, and deployment.
ABOUT.P31: → Backend 18x faster: cut critical processes from 9 minutes to 30 seconds (-94% execution time) through logic optimization and refactoring.
ABOUT.P32: → Frontend zero-freeze: fixed a critical issue where prolonged use accumulated interactions and junk data until the app froze and crashed. I designed and implemented a complete refactoring of the architecture and state management, eliminating crashes and ensuring functional stability.
ABOUT.P33: → Database tuned for scale: optimized slow queries and inserts with strategic indexing, code cleanup, and key data-model refactoring for faster reads/writes and long-term maintainability.
ABOUT.P4: 🚀 Innovation & Future — Currently, I am specializing in the integration of Artificial Intelligence applied to software development. I design agent-based workflows, automate business processes, and build with Large Language Models (LLMs). Additionally, I implement AI-assisted code review and testing systems, connecting these advanced capabilities directly into enterprise applications built with .NET and React.
ABOUT.P5: In my spare time, I enjoy consuming content related to cybersecurity and technology in general (if I'm not fighting for the long-awaited promotion 🏀, hiking in the mountains 🗻, or dreaming under the stars ⛺️🌠).
